app.stack: Flutter (crypto in libapp.so, keys via AndroidKeyStore)

key.notes: session key derived in native code and held in AndroidKeyStore — never a Java literal. Captured from EVP_EncryptInit_ex; frida-run.py --key-file rewrites this file on every renewal

verified.how: GCM tag verified with the captured key, so the key is certain

key.notes: captured from Mac.init; distinct from the AES key

integrity.notes: until the encrypt path recomputes this header, every modified request returns 401

notes: Key renews roughly every 15 minutes and on every foreground — a literal key in the UI would go stale mid-test.
GCM authenticates the ciphertext, so a wrong key fails loudly: useful for confirming a capture instantly.
